info.text:
One round of IVF can cost $25,000 or more.
A 2025 executive order put one cycle at $12,000 to $25,000: hormone drugs, lab work and specialists.
State IVF mandates don't apply to self-funded job plans, which cover 67% of covered workers (KFF, 2025).
Even under 35, 41% of egg retrievals led to a live birth in 2023 (SART), so many people pay for more than one round.
Sources: Executive Order 14216, SART, KFF.
News and education, not financial advice.
Follow @financeprostv for money explained simply.
